وُجْدٌ and ↓ وِجْدٌ and ↓ وَجْدٌ [and ↓ جِدَةٌ &c., see 1,] (the first of which is the most chaste, IKh, MF) Richness, or competence, or sufficiency; state of being in no need, or of having no wants, or few wants: (M, L, K:) ability; capacity; power. (M, L.) ―
-b2- هٰذَا مِنْ وُجْدِى This is a result of my power, or ability. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
